### What does this PR do?

Wire Qwen3 Dense native LoRA through the VeOmni actor, reference-policy inference, merged vLLM weight synchronization, and training/HF checkpoints. Related: [VeOmni #506](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/issues/506).

**Dependency:** [ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni #1337](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1337). The source pin and lockfile reference its publicly fetchable upstream commit `7a5779ff83a847b75bfe552de1cf6d62afd34a9b`. The companion review and two-GPU CI remain pending; the pin can move to the merged upstream revision if it changes.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched [VeOmni LoRA PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+VeOmni+LoRA+in%3Atitle). No overlapping native adapter integration found. #8110 concerns receiver dtype negotiation without LoRA; #8198 fixes PEFT/FSDP merged export precision. This change uses VeOmni's native wrapper and a separate non-mutating export generator.
- [x] Title follows the module/type convention.

### Test

Real hardware: one NVIDIA A800 80GB PCIe, Python 3.12.3, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, Transformers 5.16.1, vLLM 0.29.0, FlashAttention 2.8.3. Pretrained Qwen3-0.6B revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`; GSM8K subset (128 train/32 validation rows), no validation-quality claim.

```bash
python -m pytest tests/utils/veomni/test_dense_lora_on_cpu.py -q
python -m pytest tests/workers/test_veomni_parallel_init_on_cpu.py -q
# Separately, in the companion VeOmni checkout:
python -m pytest tests/lora/test_veomni_lora_native.py -q
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure
uv lock --check
```

The three suites passed 27, 8, and 19 cases respectively in separate processes. The existing parallel-init suite installs module-level dependency stubs, so it was not mixed into the native integration process. A clean install of the exact GitHub-pinned VeOmni commit also passed all 27 integration cases. All 14 verl pre-commit hooks and the lock consistency check passed; the actual shell argv also passed Hydra composition and `validate_config()` for one/two GPUs.

```bash
NUM_GPUS=1 MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3-0.6B \
TRAIN_FILES=/path/to/gsm8k/train.parquet VAL_FILES=/path/to/gsm8k/test.parquet \
OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/grpo bash examples/tuning/lora/run_qwen3_0.6b_veomni.sh \
    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.checkpoint.save_lora_only=True trainer.resume_mode=disable

NUM_GPUS=1 MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3-0.6B \
TRAIN_FILES=/path/to/gsm8k/train.parquet VAL_FILES=/path/to/gsm8k/test.parquet \
OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/resumed bash examples/tuning/lora/run_qwen3_0.6b_veomni.sh \
    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.checkpoint.save_lora_only=True \
    trainer.resume_mode=resume_path trainer.resume_from_path=/path/to/grpo/global_step_2
```

Four GRPO updates and a two-update continuation from step 2 both exited successfully. All steps had finite, nonzero gradients; all 392 adapter tensors changed between steps 2/4 and after resuming. Live actor/rollout token log-probability mean differences were 0.0042–0.0051, with a maximum of 0.236 in the four-step run. A controlled engine probe separately checked unchanged frozen parameters/reference outputs, exact next-step model/optimizer restoration, non-mutating merged export and strict HF reload; a real vLLM receiver loaded the merged checkpoint and generated tokens with selected prompt logprobs.

The default recipe uses FP32 master parameters with BF16 computation. Merging into BF16 inference weights is numerically approximate: an additional all-BF16, lr=1e-3 stress probe exceeded its provisional log-prob tolerance (maximum 0.297). No bitwise on-policy equivalence or identical stochastic GRPO trajectory after sampler restart is claimed. The single GPU run does not verify cross-rank FSDP2, CPU offload, model quality or throughput gains. Ray teardown printed a DataLoader-worker finalizer warning after both completed runs; both driver exit codes were zero and checkpoints were verified.

### API and Usage Example

```text
model_engine=veomni
actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_rank=8
actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_alpha=16
actor_rollout_ref.model.target_modules=[q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj]
actor_rollout_ref.model.lora.merge=True
```

See `examples/tuning/lora/run_qwen3_0.6b_veomni.sh`. Initial scope: Qwen3 Dense, EP1/SP1, bias=none, zero adapter dropout, no modules_to_save or lm_head adapters. `all-linear` excludes the output embedding. Expert adapters, adapter-only rollout transfer and delta-sharded sync fail explicitly. Full and adapter-only training checkpoints are supported; HF exports contain merged weights.

### Design & Code Changes

- Inject native adapters before VeOmni FSDP2 materialization, including its native pretrained/meta loader. Explicit accelerator initialization at world size one uses the unsharded path; unsupported singleton model offload is rejected.
- Export full HF-named weights with temporary FP32 B@A accumulation, without merging/unloading or modifying the live actor. This sends full base weights on every update and does not claim adapter-only bandwidth savings.
- Reuse native adapter disabling for the frozen reference; recognize native adapter metadata in the checkpoint manager.
- Add CPU contract coverage and a two-GPU GRPO step in the existing VeOmni/vLLM workflow. That new multi-GPU job has not been run on this single-GPU host.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the contribution guide.
- [x] All repository pre-commit hooks passed.
- [x] Added documentation and a runnable recipe.
- [x] Wired contract tests and two-GPU smoke training into the VeOmni/vLLM workflow.
- [ ] Human submitter review/understanding of every changed line before requesting review.
- [ ] Request project CI through the maintainer channel when ready.
- [x] No recipe submodule change.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, validation, review and drafting. Ready-for-review status does not assert that human review or maintainer GPU CI has already occurred.

+VeOmni-native Qwen3 Dense LoRA
+-----------------------------
+
+The VeOmni engine supports Qwen3 Dense native adapters with
+``actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_rank > 0`` and
+``actor_rollout_ref.model.lora.merge=True``. Use a matching VeOmni checkout
+that provides ``VeOmniLoraModel.disable_adapter()``; older revisions are
+rejected with an upgrade message. See
+``examples/tuning/lora/run_qwen3_0.6b_veomni.sh`` for a short GRPO recipe.
+With ``NUM_GPUS=1`` the recipe uses CUDA initialization without FSDP wrapping;
+multiple GPUs use meta initialization and FSDP2. Single-device initialization
+requires parameter offload and FSDP CPU offload to remain disabled.
+
+Adapters are injected before FSDP2 materialization. The native loader initializes
+or loads their weights alongside frozen base parameters. Rollout and HF export
+stream temporary merged weights without merging or unloading the live actor.
+Merged export sends full base weights each update; it does not provide the
+bandwidth benefit of adapter-only synchronization.
+
+The initial scope requires EP=1, Ulysses SP=1, ``bias=none`` and no
+``modules_to_save``, and zero adapter dropout. Configure rank/alpha/targets via
+``model.lora_rank``, ``model.lora_alpha``, and ``model.target_modules``; the
+nested Megatron ``model.lora.rank`` configuration is rejected. Output embedding / ``lm_head`` adapter targets, expert
+adapters, adapter-only synchronization and delta-sharded synchronization are
+unsupported. ``target_modules=all-linear`` expands to linear layers excluding
+the output embedding. Reference-policy inference reuses the actor with dense
+adapters temporarily disabled. Native checkpoint detection supports full and
+adapter-only training checkpoints; reconstruct the same frozen base when
+resuming an adapter-only checkpoint. HF-format export contains merged base
+weights and is distinct from the training-resume checkpoint.
+
+CPU tests exercise real tiny Qwen3 models, the patched VeOmni chunked
+log-probability backward, native weight loading, two-rank Gloo DTensor gathering,
+and checkpoint-manager round trips. The VeOmni/vLLM CI workflow runs these
+contracts and a two-GPU GRPO smoke test.

+Single-device validation used Qwen3-0.6B on one A800 80GB, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130,
+Transformers 5.16.1 and vLLM 0.29.0. Four GRPO updates completed with nonzero

+OUTPUT_DIR=${OUTPUT_DIR:-checkpoints/qwen3-0.6b-veomni-lora}
+if [ "$NUM_GPUS" = 1 ]; then

+"""Real native LoRA / Qwen3 math; no claim of GPU or rollout execution."""
+
+import copy
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers import Qwen3Config, Qwen3ForCausalLM
+
+pytest.importorskip("veomni")
+from veomni.lora import VeOmniLoraConfig, VeOmniLoraModel
+from veomni.lora.layers import LoraLinear
+
+
+def _native_model(dtype=torch.float32):
+    torch.manual_seed(17)
+    cfg = Qwen3Config(
+        vocab_size=64,
+        hidden_size=32,
+        intermediate_size=48,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        num_key_value_heads=2,
+        head_dim=8,
+        tie_word_embeddings=False,
+    )
+    cfg._attn_implementation = "eager"
+    base = Qwen3ForCausalLM(cfg).to(dtype)
+    oracle = copy.deepcopy(base)
+    model = VeOmniLoraModel(base, VeOmniLoraConfig(r=4, lora_alpha=12, target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"]))
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for module in model.modules():
+            if isinstance(module, LoraLinear):
+                module.lora_B["default"].weight.normal_(std=0.03)
+    return model, oracle
+
+
+def _export(model):
+    from verl.utils.veomni.lora import merged_dense_lora_weights
+
+    return dict(merged_dense_lora_weights(model, device="cpu"))
+
+
+def test_disable_adapter_restores_nested_and_exception_state():
+    model, base = _native_model()
+    x = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4]])
+    model.eval()
+    base.eval()
+    adapted = model(x).logits.detach()
+    assert not torch.equal(adapted, base(x).logits)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="inside"):
+        with model.disable_adapter():
+            torch.testing.assert_close(model(x).logits, base(x).logits, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            with model.disable_adapter():
+                torch.testing.assert_close(model(x).logits, base(x).logits, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(model(x).logits, base(x).logits, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            raise RuntimeError("inside")
+    torch.testing.assert_close(model(x).logits, adapted, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_merged_export_matches_forward_and_preserves_live_parameters(dtype):
+    model, receiver = _native_model(dtype)
+    model.eval()
+    receiver.eval()
+    before = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+    exported = _export(model)
+    assert set(exported) == set(receiver.state_dict())
+    assert not any("lora_" in k or "base_layer" in k for k in exported)
+    receiver.load_state_dict(exported, strict=True)
+    x = torch.tensor([[1, 3, 5, 7]])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(receiver(x).logits, model(x).logits, rtol=0.025, atol=0.002)
+    for k, v in model.state_dict().items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(v, before[k], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for k, v in _export(model).items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(v, exported[k], rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+def _step(model, optimizer, x):
+    optimizer.zero_grad()
+    loss = model(x, labels=x).loss
+    loss.backward()
+    optimizer.step()
+    return loss.detach()
+
+
+def test_qwen3_training_export_reference_and_resume(tmp_path):
+    model, receiver = _native_model()
+    x = torch.tensor([[1, 3, 5, 7, 9]])
+    base_state = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.named_parameters() if not v.requires_grad}
+    adapter_before = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.named_parameters() if v.requires_grad}
+    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad), lr=0.01)
+    _step(model, optimizer, x)
+    assert any(not torch.equal(v, dict(model.named_parameters())[k]) for k, v in adapter_before.items())
+    for k, v in base_state.items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(dict(model.named_parameters())[k], v, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    receiver.load_state_dict(_export(model), strict=True)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(receiver(x).logits, model(x).logits, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
+    with model.disable_adapter():
+        reference = model(x).logits.detach().clone()
+    torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict()}, tmp_path / "resume.pt")
+    expected_loss = _step(model, optimizer, x)
+    resumed, _ = _native_model()
+    resumed_opt = torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in resumed.parameters() if p.requires_grad), lr=0.01)
+    saved = torch.load(tmp_path / "resume.pt", weights_only=True)
+    resumed.load_state_dict(saved["model"], strict=True)
+    resumed_opt.load_state_dict(saved["optimizer"])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(_step(resumed, resumed_opt, x), expected_loss, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for k, v in model.state_dict().items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(resumed.state_dict()[k], v, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    with resumed.disable_adapter():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(resumed(x).logits, reference, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+def test_checkpoint_manager_recognizes_native_adapter():
+    from verl.utils.checkpoint.fsdp_checkpoint_manager import FSDPCheckpointManager
+
+    model, _ = _native_model()
+    manager = object.__new__(FSDPCheckpointManager)
+    manager.model = model
+    assert manager._has_lora()
+    assert manager._get_lora_train_meta(model) == {"r": 4, "lora_alpha": 12, "task_type": "CAUSAL_LM"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("world_size", "init_device", "mode"), [(1, "cuda", "ddp"), (2, "meta", "fsdp2")])
+def test_actual_accelerator_config_accepts_single_device_and_fsdp_initialization(
+    monkeypatch, world_size, init_device, mode
+):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+    from verl.workers.config import VeOmniEngineConfig
+    from verl.workers.engine.veomni import transformer_impl as impl
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("WORLD_SIZE", str(world_size))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl.dist, "get_rank", lambda: 0)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl.dist, "get_world_size", lambda: world_size)
+    initialize = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(

+        "parallel_state",
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            init_parallel_state_from_config=initialize,
+            get_parallel_state=lambda: SimpleNamespace(sp_enabled=False),
+        ),
+    )
+    engine = impl.VeOmniEngine(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(lora_rank=8, lora={"merge": True}, use_remove_padding=True),
+        engine_config=VeOmniEngineConfig(init_device=init_device, use_torch_compile=False),

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("offload_field", ["param_offload", "enable_fsdp_offload"])
+def test_single_device_rejects_fsdp_model_offload_before_mesh_creation(monkeypatch, offload_field):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+    from verl.workers.config import VeOmniEngineConfig
+    from verl.workers.engine.veomni import transformer_impl as impl
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl.dist, "get_rank", lambda: 0)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl.dist, "get_world_size", lambda: 1)

+        "parallel_state",
+        SimpleNamespace(

+def _engine_for(model):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from verl.workers.config import VeOmniEngineConfig
+    from verl.workers.engine.veomni.transformer_impl import VeOmniEngine
+
+    engine = object.__new__(VeOmniEngine)
+    engine._is_lora = True
+    engine._is_offload_param = False
+    engine._uses_fsdp2_cpu_offload_policy = True
+    engine.engine_config = VeOmniEngineConfig(forward_only=True, attn_implementation="eager")
+    engine.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        local_hf_config_path="/model",
+        local_path="/model",
+        enable_gradient_checkpointing=False,
+        lora_rank=4,
+        lora_alpha=12,
+        target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"],
+        target_parameters=None,
+        exclude_modules=None,
+        lora={"merge": True},
+        lora_adapter_path=None,
+        use_shm=False,
+    )
+    engine.module = model
+    return engine
+

+def test_engine_injects_native_lora_before_parallelization(monkeypatch):
+    from veomni.arguments import OpsImplementationConfig
+
+    from verl.workers.engine.veomni import transformer_impl as impl
+
+    _, base = _native_model()
+    engine = _engine_for(base)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "_build_ops_implementation_config", lambda _: OpsImplementationConfig())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "build_foundation_model", lambda **_: base)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "load_safetensors_index", lambda _: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "log_gpu_memory_usage", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    seen = {}
+
+    def parallelize(module, **kwargs):
+        assert isinstance(module, VeOmniLoraModel)
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return module
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "build_parallelize_model", parallelize)
+    engine._build_model_optimizer()
+    assert seen["is_peft_model"] is True
+    assert seen["adapter_path"] is None
+    assert any(p.requires_grad for p in engine.module.parameters())
+    assert all("lora_" in name for name, p in engine.module.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad)
+
+
+def test_engine_exports_merged_weights_and_disables_reference(monkeypatch):
+    from verl.workers.engine.veomni import transformer_impl as impl
+
+    model, receiver = _native_model()
+    engine = _engine_for(model)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(impl, "get_device_id", lambda: "cpu")

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("adapter_only", [False, True])
+def test_native_checkpoint_manager_roundtrip_next_step(monkeypatch, tmp_path, adapter_only):
+    from verl.trainer.config import CheckpointConfig
+    from verl.utils.checkpoint.fsdp_checkpoint_manager import FSDPCheckpointManager
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: 0)

+def merged_dense_lora_weights(model, device):
+    """Yield full HF weights, merging one dense adapter into temporary storage.
+
+    Every FSDP rank must consume this iterator in the same order. Collectives
+    gather one base parameter and (for a wrapped weight) its A/B tensors. No
+    training parameter, adapter state or optimizer storage is modified.
+    """
+    from veomni.lora import VeOmniLoraModel
+    from veomni.lora.layers import LoraLinear
+
+    if not isinstance(model, VeOmniLoraModel):
+        raise TypeError("Expected a VeOmni-native LoRA model.")
+    if model.get_lora_config().has_moe:
+        raise NotImplementedError("Merged VeOmni rollout export currently supports dense LoRA only.")
+    wrapped = {name: layer for name, layer in model.named_modules() if isinstance(layer, LoraLinear)}
+    if any(layer.merged for layer in wrapped.values()):
+        raise ValueError("Rollout export requires unmerged training adapters.")
+
+    def full(tensor):
+        tensor = tensor.detach().to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        return tensor.full_tensor() if isinstance(tensor, DTensor) else tensor.clone()
+
+    for name, param in model.state_dict().items():
+        if any(part in {"lora_A", "lora_B", "lora_embedding_A", "lora_embedding_B"} for part in name.split(".")):

+            tensor = full(param)
+            layer_name = name.removesuffix(".base_layer.weight")
+            if layer_name in wrapped:
+                layer = wrapped[layer_name]
+                adapter = layer.active_adapter
+                a = full(layer.lora_A[adapter].weight)
+                b = full(layer.lora_B[adapter].weight)
+                # FP32 accumulation also supports BF16 adapters on CPU; cast
+                # only the temporary result back to the base storage dtype.
+                tensor = torch.addmm(tensor.float(), b.float(), a.float(), beta=1, alpha=layer.scaling[adapter]).to(

+                )
+            hf_name = name.removeprefix("base_model.model.").replace(".base_layer.", ".")
+        yield hf_name, tensor
